subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `announceTarget` through both `sessions_spawn` and global/per-agent configuration, with parent routing suppressing channel delivery and failing closed when the parent cannot be awakened?
rationale: This changes public tool and configuration surfaces, persisted routing policy, session wakeup behavior, and the user-visible failure mode; implementation correctness cannot choose that permanent product contract.

options.title: Narrow to per-spawn first
options.body: Keep explicit caller-selected routing but remove global and per-agent defaults until maintainers have evidence that persistent policy is necessary.

options.title: Approve the full contract
options.body: Accept the additive tool and configuration surfaces, channel default, persisted routing, and no-channel-fallback parent behavior.

options.title: Defer native routing
options.body: Keep current channel completion behavior and continue using explicit callback workflows while orchestration policy is redesigned.

recommendation.title: Narrow to per-spawn first
recommendation.body: Keep explicit caller-selected routing but remove global and per-agent defaults until maintainers have evidence that persistent policy is necessary.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged history spans `sessions_spawn`, session handoff, and subagent lifecycle behavior, making them the best available decision owner.
